verses.en: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.sm: Lo‘u nuu e, ia outou faalogologo mai i la‘u tulafono; ia uai mai o outou taliga i upu a lo‘u gutu.

verses.en: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
verses.sm: Ou te tautala atu lava i le faataoto; ou te ta‘u atu mea lilo talu anamuā,

verses.en: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.sm: o mea na tatou faalogologo i ai, ma tatou iloa; na talaina mai foi ia te i tatou e o tatou tamā.

verses.en: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
verses.sm: Tatou te le natia ia mea i a latou fanau, a e ta‘uta‘u atu i tupulaga amuli o viiga o Ieova, ma lona malosi, ma ona vavega na na faia.

verses.en: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
verses.sm: Ua ia faatuina le tulafono ia Iakopo, ua ia tuuina foi le poloaiga ia Isaraelu, o mea na ia poloai atu ai i o tatou tamā, ina ia latou faailoa ai i a latou fanau;

verses.en: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
verses.sm: ina ia iloa ai e le tupulaga amuli, o fanau lava e fanau mai; e tutupu mai i latou, ma ta‘u atu ai i a latou fanau;

verses.en: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
verses.sm: ina ia fai le Atua mo latou faatuatuaga; ma ia le galo galuega a le Atua; a ia latou tausi i ana poloaiga;

verses.en: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
verses.sm: ina ia le pei o latou tamā i latou, o le tupulaga vaogata ma le fouvale; o le tupulaga na le sauni o latou loto; e lei faamaoni foi o latou loto i le Atua.

verses.en: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Efaraima ua i ai auupega, e na fanafana i u; na liutua i latou i le aso na tau ai le taua.

verses.en: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
verses.sm: Na latou le tausia le feagaiga a le Atua, na le mafafai foi ona latou savavali i lana tulafono;

verses.en: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
verses.sm: na latou faagalogaloina foi ana galuega, ma ona vavega na ia faaali ia te i latou.

verses.en: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.sm: Na ia faia vavega i luma o latou tamā i le nuu o Aikupito o le laueleele o Soana.

verses.en: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
verses.sm: Na ia vavaeina le sami, ma faaui ane ai i latou; na ia faatuina foi le suāsami e pei o se mea maupuepue.

verses.en: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
verses.sm: Na ia ta‘ita‘i ia te i latou ina o ao i le ao a o le malamalama o le afi na ia ta‘ita‘i ai ia te i latou i le po atoa.

verses.en: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
verses.sm: Na ia vaevaea papa i le vao; na ia faainu ia i latou e peiseai sa i ai vai loloto.

verses.en: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.sm: Na ia faaoso foi o vaitafe nai le papa, na ia faatafe ifo le vai e pei o vaitafe.

verses.en: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
verses.sm: A ua faaopoopo ona toe agasala atu i latou ia te ia, i lo latou faaonoono i lē Silisili ese i le nuu naumati.

verses.en: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
verses.sm: Na latou tofotofo i le Atua i o latou loto i lo latou ole atu i mea e ‘ai i lo latou tu‘inanau.

verses.en: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
verses.sm: Na upuia le Atua e i latou; ua faapea a latou, Ua mafaia ea e le Atua ona laulau mai mea e ‘ai i le vao?

verses.en: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
verses.sm: Faauta, na ia taia le papa, ua tafe mai ai le vai; ona oso ai lea i tua o vaitafe; e mafaia foi ea ona foai mai ni mea e ‘ai? E mafaia ea ona aumai o aano o manu mā lona nuu?

verses.en: Therefore the LORD heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
verses.sm: O le mea lea na faafofoga mai ai Ieova, ona toasa ai ai lea o ia; na tŭtŭ ai le afi ia Iakopo, na oo ae foi le toatamai ia Isaraelu;

verses.en: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:
verses.sm: auā ua latou le faatuatua i le Atua, ua latou le faalagolago i le olataga mai ia te ia.

verses.en: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
verses.sm: Na ia poloai i ao mai luga; na ia to mai foi o puipui o le lagi,

verses.en: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
verses.sm: na ia faatotō faaua i luga ia te i latou le manai e aai ai; na ia avatua foi ia te i latou o mea e ‘ai mai le lagi.

verses.en: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.
verses.sm: Na aai tagata i le mea e ‘ai a e malolosi; na ia tuuina atu ia te i latou le mea e ‘ai latou te maoona ai.

verses.en: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
verses.sm: Na ia faaoso mai i le lagi le matagi mai sasaē, o lona malosi foi na ia faaagi mai ai le toga.

verses.en: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
verses.sm: Na ia faatotō faaua foi i luga ia te i latou o manu e pei o le efuefu; o manu felelei foi e pei o le oneone i le sami;

verses.en: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
verses.sm: na ia faatotōina ai i totonu i lo latou toagālauapi; e faataaliolio ai i mea sa latou nonofo ai.

verses.en: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
verses.sm: Na latou aai, ona matuā maoona ai lea o i latou; auā na ia avatu ia te i latou o mea na latou tu‘inanau i ai.

verses.en: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
verses.sm: Na le te‘a i latou i le mea na latou tu‘inanau i ai; a o i o latou gutu a latou mea e ‘ai,

verses.en: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.
verses.sm: ua oo ai ia te i latou le toasa o le Atua, ua fasiotia foi o latou tagata puputa, ma na lafo i lalo taulelea o Isaraelu.

verses.en: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
verses.sm: E ui lava i ia mea uma, a ua latou agasala pea; e ui lava i ona vavega, a e latou te lei faatuatua lava.

verses.en: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
verses.sm: Ona faaumatia faaleaoga ai lea e ia o latou olaga, na faaumatia foi o latou tausaga i le atuatuvale.

verses.en: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.
verses.sm: Na latou sailiili atu ia te ia ina o fasiotia i latou e ia; ona latou foi ai lea i le sailiili i latou i le Atua.

verses.en: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.
verses.sm: Ona latou manatu ifo ai lea o le Atua o lo latou papa ia; o le Atua silisili o ia na te faaolaina i latou.

verses.en: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
verses.sm: A ua latou pepelo ia te ia i o latou gutu, ma ua latou faa‘ole‘ole ia te ia i o latou laulaufaiva.

verses.en: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
verses.sm: E lei tutumau foi o latou loto ia te ia, e lei faamaoni foi latou i lana feagaiga.

verses.en: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
verses.sm: A o ia, ua alofa mutimuti vale, ua ia faamagaloina a latou amio leaga; na ia le faaumatia ai i latou; ua liliu ese faalasi e ia lona toasa, na ia le faatupuina foi lona toatamai atoatoa;

verses.en: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
verses.sm: auā na ia manatua, ua na o tagata lava i latou; o le matagi o loo mavae atu, e le toe foi mai lava.

verses.en: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
verses.sm: Na faalasi naua ona latou faaonoono ia te ia i le vao; na latou faalili lava ia te ia i le vao.

verses.en: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.
verses.sm: Na latou toe tofotofo lava i le Atua; ma latou faaonoono i le Paia o Isaraelu.

verses.en: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
verses.sm: Latou te lei manatua lona aao, o le aso na ia faaolaina ai i latou ai le puapuaga;

verses.en: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
verses.sm: o ona faailoga na na faia i Aikupito, atoa ma ona vavega i le laueleele o Soana.

verses.en: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
verses.sm: Na ia liua foi o latou vaitafe ma toto, atoa ma o latou vaita‘i, ina ia latou le inu ai.

verses.en: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.sm: Na ia aauina atu ia te i latou o garova, na ‘aina ai i latou; o rane foi na faaumatia ai i latou.

verses.en: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
verses.sm: Na ia avatua foi o fua o lo latou fanua i le sē kasili, na avatua foi a latou galuega i le sē akerise.

verses.en: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
verses.sm: Na ia faamateina o a latou vine i le uato‘a, na ia faamateina foi a latou sukamoru i le uato‘a tetele.

verses.en: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.sm: Na ia tuuina atu foi o a latou manu i le uato‘a ma na tuuina a latou lafu mamoe i le uila.

verses.en: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
verses.sm: Na ia faaoo ia te i latou o lona toasa mamafa, o le ma‘ema‘eā, le toatamai, ma le puapuaga, i lona aauina atu o auauna e i ai mala.

verses.en: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
verses.sm: Ua na saunia le ala o lona toasa; e lei faasaoina e ia o i latou i le oti, a ua tuuina atu o latou ola i le faamai;

verses.en: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
verses.sm: na ia fasia foi ulumatua uma i Aikupito; o le amataga o lo latou malosi na i fale ie o Hamo.

verses.en: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.sm: Na ia aumaia foi lona nuu e pei o mamoe, ma na ta‘ita‘iina i latou i le vao e pei o se lafu.

verses.en: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.sm: Na ia ta‘ita‘iina i latou ua saogalemu, o lea na le fefefe ai i latou; a o e ua ita i ai, ua lofia i latou i le sami.

verses.en: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
verses.sm: Na ia faaoo ia te i latou i lona laueleele paia, o lenei lava mauga na ia maua i lona aao taumatau.

verses.en: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.sm: Na ia tulia foi nuu ese i o latou luma, ona vaevaeina atu lea e ia ia te i latou le tofi ua fuatia, ma na faanonofo o itu aiga o Isaraelu i o latou fale ie.

verses.en: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
verses.sm: A ua latou tofotofo ma faaonoono i le Atua silisili ese; e lei tausi foi e i latou ana tulafono.

verses.en: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.sm: Ua toe liliu i latou, ma faa‘ole‘ole e pei o latou tamā; ua liua i latou e pei o le aufana ua pepelo.

verses.en: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
verses.sm: Na latou faalili foi ia te ia i a latou mea maualuluga; na latou faatupuina foi lona fuā i a latou tupua ua ta.

verses.en: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
verses.sm: Ua faafofoga le Atua, ona toasa tele ai lea o ia, ona matuā ‘ino‘ino ai lea o ia ia Isaraelu;

verses.en: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
verses.sm: na ia lafoai ai le malumalu i Sailo, o le fale fetafai sa mau ai o ia ma tagata.

verses.en: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.
verses.sm: Na ia tuuina atu foi lona malosi ia tāfea, na ia tuuina atu foi lona matagofie i le lima o le ua ita mai.

verses.en: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
verses.sm: Na ia tuuina foi o lona nuu i le pelu, ma ua toasa tele ia i lona lava tofi.

verses.en: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
verses.sm: O latou taulelea ua faaumatia i le afi; o latou taupou foi ua le viia i latou.

verses.en: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
verses.sm: O latou faitaulaga, ua oti i latou i le pelu; e lei taufaiaue foi a latou avā.

verses.en: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
verses.sm: Ona maleifua ai lea o le Alii e peiseai na tofa, e pei o se tagata malosi ua alaga ona o le uaina.

verses.en: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.sm: Ua na taia e ua ita ia te ia i o latou tua; ua na faia lea mo latou luma e faavavau.

verses.en: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
verses.sm: Na ia tetee atu foi i le fale ie o Iosefa, na ia le filifilia foi le itu aiga o Efaraima.

verses.en: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
verses.sm: A ua ia filifilia le itu aiga o Iuta, o le mauga o Siona na ia finagalo i ai.

verses.en: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.
verses.sm: Ua na faia foi o lona malumalu e pei o mea maualuluga, e pei o le lalolagi na ia faavaeina e faavavau lava.

verses.en: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
verses.sm: Ua na filifilia foi Tavita lana auauna, ma na aumaia o ia nai lotoā mamoe;

verses.en: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
verses.sm: na ia aumaia o ia sa mulimuli i mamoe fananau, ina ia fafaga lava e ia ia Iakopo lona nuu, o Isaraelu foi lona tofi.

verses.en: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
verses.sm: Na fafaga foi e ia ia te i latou e tusa ma le faamaoni o lona loto; na ia ta‘ita‘i ia te i latou i le poto o ona lima.
